sample.text: Everything in this harbour is made up, except the kind of room in that window. It is a chat room, the very example Durable Objects began with, in 2020. Someone types message forty-two: the ferry is late. It waits at the door. Then it gets its tick: a promise that it is saved. Then House A goes dark, and the square goes quiet. Up the hill, House C lights. Its keeper, the runtime, draws a bundle from the well, and the room relights in a new window. Message forty-two is still there, with its tick. The machine that made that promise is gone. The promise is still true.
